title: Diagnostic Fees, After-Hours Premiums and Member Fee Rates on Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
## Billing standard

**Fees at completion.** When the technician completes a visit on a call under Repair and Emergency Service Calls, it is charged the class's diagnostic fee. In the Evening, Weekend, Overnight Emergency and Holiday Emergency classes it is also charged the class's after-hours premium. A maintenance request call is charged the tune-up price instead of a diagnostic fee.

**Posting gate.** Charges are posted only to a call in dispatched, completed or cancelled status. The status is read from the call record of the same call.

**Member diagnostic rate.** A Comfort Club member whose agreement is active on the completion date pays the member diagnostic fee of the member's Comfort Club tier instead of the diagnostic fee. This is posted as a member diagnostic rate discount equal to the difference between the class's diagnostic fee and the tier's member diagnostic fee, and never less than zero.

**Retired clause, no longer in force.** The former clause under which such a member received the tier's after-hours premium discount percentage off the premium of an Evening, Weekend or Overnight Emergency call, or the tier's holiday premium discount percentage off the premium of a Holiday Emergency call, posted as a member premium discount, is no longer in force. The member premium discount on after-hours calls is now governed by the current member premium discount basis.

**Courtesy program.** The courtesy discount program never applies to the diagnostic fee or the premium.

**Line and rounding.** Each discount names the fee line it reduces and is rounded to the cent half up.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A member whose agreement is active on the completion date has a Standard Service Call. The class diagnostic fee is $89.00, and the member's tier lists a member diagnostic fee of $49.00 (an illustrative tier figure). The member diagnostic rate discount is $89.00 less $49.00, which is $40.00. It names the diagnostic fee line. If the tier's member fee were $0.00, the discount would be the full $89.00.

## Points of judgement

- A call still in booked status receives no charge lines.
- A member whose agreement is past due on the completion date pays the class's diagnostic fee.
- A maintenance request call carries the tune-up charge, not a diagnostic fee.
